name: Ask a clear question
short_description: Ask one complete question that identifies the information needed in an ordinary exchange.
self_assessment: I can ask one clear question and obtain a relevant answer without help.
description: Ask one complete question that identifies the information needed in an ordinary exchange. The stated threshold defines a repeatable capability that can be demonstrated in a fresh but ordinary context. It covers preparation, execution, and checking the result within the named conditions. It excludes a one-off task or dependence on a particular product, institution, culture, or living arrangement, so the holder can assess and retain it as a transferable skill.
